dedupe_keys.name: pre above active layer thickness and soil water content barrow 2013

description: NASA ORNL DAAC publishes active-layer thickness and soil-water estimates from four sites around Barrow, Alaska, surveyed in August 2013. Ground-penetrating radar transects extend approximately 1–7 km and are accompanied by mechanical probing, including one-metre measurements along selected 100-m sections. Volumetric water content was calculated at three to eight colocated calibration points per site, and uncertainty estimates accompany the results. The repository offers CSV files under the EOSDIS policy of open sharing without restriction; Earthdata registration is the acquisition route. These observations can calibrate permafrost and ground-thermal simulations used to examine road or foundation exposure to thaw. They complement larger ABoVE permafrost products with local measurements, not continuous regional coverage. The short summer campaign cannot establish multi-year ground movement or infrastructure damage. Soil-water values are derived estimates, and their uncertainty should be propagated when interpreting thaw conditions.
